name: Ithacan Sailor
art: A weathered young sailor in a short tunic hauls on a rope at the side of a small Greek ship.

name: Puccio Sciancato
art: A limping thief in a ragged cloak glances back over his shoulder as serpents coil on the rocks around him.

name: Tongue of Flame
art: A single tall flame shaped like a tongue flickers above a dark rocky ditch, sparks flying from its tip.

name: Counterfeit Florins
art: A pile of gold coins spills from a crucible on a forge, a hammer and a coin die beside them.

name: Forged Will
art: A hand holding a quill signs a long parchment by candlelight while a dead man lies in the bed behind.

name: Turn the Prow
art: A small Greek ship swings its curved prow around on a dark sea, its sail filling with wind.

name: Old Companions
art: Three grey-bearded sailors sit together at the oars of a ship, tired but still pulling.

name: Wandering Flames
art: Dozens of small flames drift like fireflies along the bottom of a deep stone valley at night.

name: Griffolino of Arezzo
art: A scrawny alchemist in a stained robe stands on a rooftop with his arms spread as if to fly.

name: Beacon Keeper
art: A hooded man raises a burning torch beside a tall signal fire on a cliff above the sea.

name: Achaean in Hiding
art: A Greek soldier crouches in the dark belly of a wooden structure, gripping his sword and holding his breath.

name: Barbed Counsel
art: A cloaked adviser whispers into the ear of a crowned king, a thin dagger hidden behind his back.

name: Spoils of Troy
art: Greek soldiers carry chests, golden cups and bronze shields out of a burning city gate.

name: Buoso Donati
art: A man's body twists as his legs turn into the tail of a great serpent, smoke rising around him.

name: Oarsmen of Ithaca
art: A row of muscular oarsmen bend to their long oars in the hull of a galley on rough water.

name: Gilded Hypocrite
art: A hooded monk trudges forward under a heavy cloak that shines like gold but drags like lead.

name: Burning Counsellor
art: An old adviser in a long robe stands wrapped in a column of fire, one hand raised as he speaks.

name: Speech of Fire
art: A flame bends and shapes itself into a speaking mouth, words of sparks pouring out over a ravine.

name: Eurypylus, the Augur
art: A Greek augur in a white robe reads the flight of birds above a beach full of ships.

name: Night Raid
art: Two Greek warriors creep through an enemy camp at night, spears low, past sleeping guards.

name: The Little Ship
art: A small single-masted Greek ship sails alone across a vast open sea under a low sky.

name: Past the Pillars
art: A small ship sails between two enormous stone pillars rising from the sea at the edge of the world.

name: Achaean Captain
art: A Greek captain in a crested bronze helmet raises his sword and shouts orders to his men.

name: Epeius, Horse-Builder
art: A bearded carpenter with an adze works on the huge wooden leg of an unfinished horse.

name: The Sweet Siren
art: A pale siren sits on a rock above the waves and sings, her long hair blowing toward a passing ship.

name: Fra Gomita
art: A friar with a sly smile weighs a fat purse of coins in his hand behind a judge's bench.

name: Absolved in Advance
art: A pope in a tall tiara raises two fingers in blessing over a kneeling knight in armour.

name: Curio, the Tongueless
art: A Roman tribune in a torn toga stands mute in a dark ravine, one hand pressed over his mouth.

name: Potiphar's Wife
art: A richly dressed Egyptian noblewoman holds up a torn cloak and points accusingly into the shadows.

name: Circe's Draught
art: A golden cup of glowing potion is held out by a woman's hand, a pig sniffing at the floor below.

name: Calchas, the Augur
art: An old seer with a staff stands on a shore at dawn, pointing at the sky above a fleet of ships.

name: Sinon, the False Greek
art: A Greek prisoner in chains pleads before Trojan soldiers, a giant wooden horse looming behind him.

name: False Beacon
art: A bonfire burns on a rocky headland at night, luring a ship toward jagged reefs.

name: Envoy to Troy
art: A Greek envoy in a travelling cloak bows before the high walls and gate of Troy.

name: The Greek Ambush
art: Greek soldiers leap from tall reeds by a riverbank, spears raised, onto a startled patrol.

name: Arms of Achilles
art: A magnificent bronze shield, helmet and spear lie on a cloth before a crowd of Greek chiefs.

name: Theft of the Palladium
art: Two Greek warriors carry a small wooden statue of a goddess out of a dark temple at night.

name: The Two-Horned Flame
art: One great flame split at the top into two horns burns in a deep ravine, two faces dimly inside it.

name: Simon Magus
art: A sorcerer in a dark robe holds out a bag of silver toward two robed apostles who turn away.

name: Capocchio, the Ape
art: A scabby alchemist crouches over a bench of flasks and mimics the pose of a man before him like an ape.

name: Valley of Flames
art: A deep stone valley seen from a bridge above, filled from end to end with countless moving flames.

name: The Little Speech
art: An old captain stands at the mast and speaks to his gathered crew, all of them turned toward the sunset.

name: Deidamia, the Deceived
art: A young princess weeps alone in a palace room, holding a dress left behind on an empty chair.

name: Diomedes, the Twin Flame
art: A Greek warrior in a plumed helmet stands inside a tall flame, a second figure sharing the fire beside him.

name: The Trojan Horse
art: A gigantic wooden horse on wheels stands before the walls of Troy, a hatch half open in its belly.

name: The Black Cherub
art: A black-winged demon swoops down and seizes a dying friar's soul from the hands of a saint.

name: Circe, the Enchantress
art: A sorceress on a stone throne raises a wand over men who are turning into pigs at her feet.

name: The Distant Mountain
art: A dark mountain rises from the open sea while a whirlwind spins a small ship toward the waves.

name: Achaean Raider
art: A Greek soldier in a bronze helmet charges forward with a short sword and a round shield.

name: Swine of Circe
art: A bewildered pig with strangely human eyes stands in the straw of a sty.
